about.title: About Us
about.description: Akar Karya, the roots of craft. Born from one person's determination to build a furniture company from the ground up, every piece is made to order and crafted by hand by local Indonesian artisans. More than furniture — it's a way to bring artisanry into your home while growing our local economy.
about.purpose: We want to raise the standard of Indonesian furniture: better quality, at prices that stay fair and competitive in their class. Like roots that grow and bloom outward, we hope to reach homes all around the world.
about.showcaseAlt: Handcrafted wooden armchair with a woven rattan seat and back, beside a potted plant
about.photoAlt: Person relaxing with a book in a wood-framed lounge chair with linen cushions
